common_kernel_cone_theorem.exact_statement: On any finite nonempty positive probability space (X,mu),let S be an ACTUAL self-adjoint entrywise nonnegative PSD Markov kernel relative to originalmu. Let I(x,y)=1_(x=y)/mu_y and Pi(x,y)=1. Independently for each of the6edges e ofK4,choose a_e,b_e,c_e>=0 with a_e+b_e+c_e=1,and set L_e=a_e I+b_e S+c_e Pi. Then E_(x_a,x_b,x_c,x_d iidmu) product_e L_e(x_v,x_w)>=1.
common_kernel_cone_theorem.precise_scope: One common actual S is essential. This does not assert positivity for independently chosen or merely commuting nonnegative PSD Markov kernels. I and intermediate kernels may be unbounded as kernels; they remain finite and all composition/integration uses originalmu.
primitive_facts: Since S is self-adjoint PSD and S1=1,constants form an invariant eigenspace and S-Pi is PSD,even with disconnected components and additional unit modes.
Thus S(x,x)>=1 by testing the PSD kernelS-Pi against a point mass. Also I(x,x)=1/mu_x>=1.
The Schur square R(x,y)=S(x,y)^2 is PSD. In weighted orthonormal coordinates this follows from Schur product and diagonal congruence; it is NOT the operator power S^2.
Tr S^j>=1 for every positive integerj,since the constant eigenvalue contributes1 and all other eigenvalues are nonnegative. Operatorpowers and Hadamard powers are distinguished below.
mixture_and_contraction_proof: Expand the6convex mixtures. There are3^6=729 elementary assignments ofI,S,Pi to the edges. Their nonnegative coefficients sum to1. It suffices to prove that EVERY elementary assignment has density>=1.

For the subgraph ofIedges,choose a spanning forest having the same components. On the support of its equality constraints,every discarded cyclicIedge equals1/mu_x>=1;off this support,the forest product is0. All remainingS/Pi factors are nonnegative,so deleting cyclicIedges lowers the density.

Contract each I-tree. A tree component withsvertices ands-1forestIedges contributes mu_x^s mu_x^(-(s-1))=mu_x. Hence each quotient vertex is integrated against ORIGINALmu,not a renormalized measure. ParallelSedges are retained individually; Pi edges can simply be deleted.
Any Sedge becoming an internal loop has valueS(x,x)>=1,so may be deleted for a lower bound while every remaining factor is nonnegative.

With4quotientvertices there are noIedges,and the retainedSgraph is a simple subgraph ofK4. Its leaf-stripped core is empty,a triangle,a4cycle,a diamond,orK4. The bounds for each core are supplied below.

With3 quotient vertices,the original vertices have partition sizes(2,1,1). Its Sedge multiplicities are bounded by(2,2,1). Every retained subgraph has multiplicities s,t in{0,1,2} on the two edges incident to the merged vertex,and v in{0,1} on the remaining edge. All18 possibilities(17 nonempty and the empty graph)are bounded below as detailed below.
With2quotientvertices,the partition sizes are(3,1) or(2,2). At most3or4parallelSedges remain. Their density is E_xy S(x,y)^n>=1 by Jensen since E_xy S=1,for n>=1;the n=0graph has density1.
With1quotientvertex all remainingSedges are loops already removed,and its final density is1. Therefore all729elementary assignments,and their convex combination,have density>=1.

simple_four_vertex_core_bounds.forest: Repeated leaf deletion uses S1=1; isolated vertices contribute1,so density=1.
simple_four_vertex_core_bounds.triangle_and_four_cycle: Their densities are Tr S^3 andTr S^4,both>=1. Attached leaves do not change them.
simple_four_vertex_core_bounds.diamond: Its density is E_cd S(c,d)[S^2(c,d)]^2,where S^2 is OPERATOR composition. Since S(c,d)mu_cmu_d is a probability measure,Jensen gives at least[E S(c,d)S^2(c,d)]^2=[Tr S^3]^2>=1.
simple_four_vertex_core_bounds.full_K4: Let f_cd(x)=S(x,c)S(x,d). Its density is E_cd S(c,d)<f_cd,Sf_cd>. Since S-Pi is PSD,this is at least E_cd S(c,d)(E_x f_cd)^2=E_cd S(c,d)[S^2(c,d)]^2. The diamond bound then gives t(K4,S)>=[Tr S^3]^2>=1. This is a complete self-contained finite proof,not an assumption of centered tetrahedron positivity.

three_vertex_multigraph_bounds.v_zero: For s,t in{0,1,2},the density is E_a[E_b S(a,b)^s][E_c S(a,c)^t]. Each bracket is>=1:1for exponent0,exactly1for exponent1,and>=1for exponent2by rowwise Jensen. Their product is therefore>=1.
three_vertex_multigraph_bounds.v_one_and_s_or_t_zero: A degree-one vertex integrates away with S1=1. The remaining graph is a single ordinary or double edge,or an empty graph; its density is1or E S^2>=1. This also covers s=t=0.
three_vertex_multigraph_bounds.two_one_one_or_one_two_one: Let R=S Hadamard S,so R is PSD. Integrating the third vertex gives densityTr(R S^2),where S^2 is operatorcomposition. Since S^2-Pi is PSD and the trace of a product of two PSD operators is nonnegative,this is at leastTr(R Pi)=E_xy S(x,y)^2>=1.
three_vertex_multigraph_bounds.two_two_one: Integrating the merged vertex gives densityTr(S R^2),where R^2 is operatorcomposition. Since S-Pi is PSD and R^2 is PSD,this is at leastTr(Pi R^2)=||R1||_L2(mu)^2>=[E_xy S(x,y)^2]^2>=1. All traces and norms use originalmu.

common_kernel_cone_theorem.edge_cases: Zero Sentries,zero eigenvalues,repeated eigenvalues,additional unit modes,disconnected S and arbitrarily unequal positive mu are all permitted. No division by an eigenvalue occurs. On a singleton I=Pi=S and equality holds. General independent edge mixtures can have equality for reasons such as deleting enoughedges; no full equality classification of this cone theorem is claimed.

arbitrary_rank_two_level_corollary.exact_statement: Let P be ANY real orthogonal projection on originalL2(mu) withP1=0,let0<=y<=x<=1,and suppose A=yI+(1-y)Pi+(x-y)P is ACTUALLY entrywise nonnegative. Then for EVERY6positive integer edge exponents n_e, E product_(e inK4) A^(n_e)(x_v,x_w)>=1. There is no exponent-order hypothesis and no rank-one requirement onP. In particular,this covers the requested ordered tuple whenever the actual A=T^2 has this complete spectralform.
arbitrary_rank_two_level_corollary.power_identity: By mutually orthogonal spectralprojections, A^j=y^j I+(1-y^j)Pi+(x^j-y^j)P for everyj>=1. All coefficients multiplyingPi andP here are not by themselves being claimed to be a nonnegative kernel mixture.
arbitrary_rank_two_level_corollary.actual_common_S: Ify<1,put tau=(x-y)/(1-y) and S=Pi+tau P. Off diagonal,S(x,z)=A(x,z)/(1-y)>=0;on diagonal,S(x,x)=1+tau P(x,x)>=1 becauseP is PSD. ThusS is actual nonnegative self-adjoint PSD Markov,withcentered spectrumtau onP and0onits complement.
arbitrary_rank_two_level_corollary.mixture_membership: For y<1 andx>y,put tau_j=(x^j-y^j)/(1-y^j). Then A^j=y^j I+(1-y^j)S_j,where S_j=Pi+tau_jP. The ratio tau_j/tau=[sum_(a=0)^(j-1)x^(j-1-a)y^a]/[sum_(a=0)^(j-1)y^a]<=1 sincex<=1. Therefore S_j=(1-tau_j/tau)Pi+(tau_j/tau)S,so every A^j lies inconv{I,Pi,S}. Apply the cone theorem independently at all6edges.
boundaries: Ifx=y<1,then A=yI+(1-y)Pi and A^j=y^jI+(1-y^j)Pi directly belongs to the cone withS=Pi;no0/0ratio is used.
Ify=1,thenx=1 andA=I. The density is sum_z mu_z^(-2)>=1,computed from6identity kernels and4originalmeasures.
Ify=0,then the corollary reduces to the previously covered flat positive-band case,including an arbitrary zero complement;this boundary is not claimed as newcoverage.
For x>y>0,the complete centered spectrum must consist ONLY ofxandy. An additional zero complement would be a third centered value and is NOTcovered bythis representation.
P can have arbitrary multiplicity,includingzero/fullcenteredrank;all spectralforms are basis invariant. Nonconstant unit modes atx=1 are permitted,so irreducibility is notassumed.
arbitrary_rank_two_level_corollary.strictness: For |X|>=2,equality inthis corollary occurs exactlywhen A=Pi. Ify>0,the allIassignment in the6mixture expansion has positiveweight y^(sum n_e) and densitysum mu^-2>1. Ify=0,x>0,andP!=0,the allSassignment has positiveweight product x^(n_e-1),while t(K4,S)>=[Tr S^3]^2=(1+rank(P)x^3)^2>1. The remaining caseA=Pi has density1. Singleton equalityis automatic.
arbitrary_rank_two_level_corollary.genuine_scope_extension: The prior lazy-one-spike theorem required a simple exceptional TOPcentered eigenvalue. This proof allows arbitrary top-band multiplicity,so forinstance4-statehosts withtopmultiplicity2andpositivebottommultiplicity1 arecovered. This extends a restricted analytical hostclass;it does notsolve generalinteracting spectra or clear novelty.

what_remains_open.general_prefix: No proof of complete spectralprefixnonnegativity or its Gram/error domination on arbitraryhosts was found. The cone theorem bypasses that unproved premise on the stated two-levelclass.
what_remains_open.unrestricted_target: Generalhosts with three ormore interacting positivecenteredbands,or two positivebands plus a genuinely nonconditional zero complement,remain outside the newcorollary. No arbitraryfinitealphabet entropy theorem follows from this restricted density result.
what_remains_open.noncircularity: Every cone assignment is discharged by a self-contained finite graph/kernelbound. The target itself,the centered tetrahedrumsign or a weighted-inner-productPSD assertion is not accepted as a primitive.
